descriptions.w3d_d41z_vfprintf_r_802f07a0: SN ProDG's _vfprintf_r: newlib printf with 64-bit formats and SN's cvt for %e, %f and %g, where %g picks the form through log10. PRINT copies into string streams (flag 0x200) or feeds the console writer; no __sprint buffering, no error path. Names follow newlib.
